content: Every request carries Authorization: Bearer <key>. Access tokens last one hour. Keys are never accepted in a query parameter, and a sandbox key is rejected by the production host.

The default limit is 600 requests per minute per key. X-RateLimit-Remaining reports the quota left; a throttled request returns 429 with Retry-After in seconds. Every request counts, including failures.
March: added the /webhooks/replay endpoint. April: raised the default rate limit. June: deprecated query-parameter keys. September: idempotency keys now expire after 24 hours.
